BREAKING: Italy is preparing to join the growing list of countries adopting Starlink Direct to Cell. 🇮🇹

Starlink and Fastweb + Vodafone will begin testing satellite-to-phone connectivity in Italy, starting in the central Apennine Mountains.

• Works with standard 4G LTE smartphones
• Automatically switches to Starlink when cellular coverage is lost
• SMS and mobile data continue without manual setup
• No satellite phone, external antenna, or additional hardware required

Another milestone as Starlink expands direct satellite connectivity to everyday smartphones across the globe.

🚗 Full walkthrough of the all-new 2026 Tesla Model Y L Launch Series — Tesla’s new long-wheelbase 6-seater electric SUV!

We take you on a complete exterior and interior tour of the stretched Model Y L Premium, showing the extra space and family-friendly features now arriving at select US showrooms.

**Launch Series Key Specs (Model Y L Premium AWD):**
• Seating: 6 passengers in a spacious 2-2-2 configuration with second-row captain’s chairs
• Range: Up to 325 miles EPA estimated
• Performance: Dual-motor all-wheel drive with strong acceleration (0-60 mph in around 5 seconds)
• Battery: Long-range pack
• Wheelbase: Significantly extended for much more rear legroom and third-row comfort
• Key features: Adaptive suspension, premium interior with rear climate controls, V2L (Vehicle-to-Load) capability

**Price:** The US Launch Series starts at $61,990.

The Model Y L is Tesla’s stretched version of the popular Model Y, designed to offer proper 6-passenger seating without moving up to a larger vehicle.

What Success Looks Like for Starship Flight 13

SpaceX is targeting Thursday, July 16 for Starship Flight 13, the second flight of the upgraded V3 vehicle.

Here’s what a successful mission would look like:

•  Booster: Completes a clean launch, stage separation, boostback burn, and performs a controlled landing burn into the Gulf of Mexico.
•  Upper Stage: Successfully deploys 20 functioning Starlink V3 satellites (first real V3 deployment, not simulators).
•  In-space Raptor relight: Successfully restarts a Raptor engine while in space.
•  Reentry & Splashdown: Controlled entry, descent, and splashdown in the Indian Ocean with good heat shield performance.
•  Overall: Strong data collection on the V3 design improvements with no major anomalies.
Hitting most or all of these objectives would be considered a strong success and would build momentum toward higher cadence and more complex missions (like booster catch attempts) on upcoming flights.

GROK BUILD IS NOW OPEN SOURCE

xAI has open-sourced Grok Build, making the full codebase publicly available for anyone to use, improve, and build on.

This is a significant step toward transparency and community-driven development of powerful AI coding tools. By open-sourcing the harness and CLI, developers everywhere can now contribute to making Grok Build more robust and reliable.

Alongside this, usage limits have been reset for all users, giving broader access to the platform.
Open sourcing Grok Build aligns with xAI’s goal of accelerating scientific discovery and building AI that benefits humanity as a whole — not locking it behind closed doors.
